text:
alex_m: Heads up — planning a staged upgrade of the regional switch core (APAC + EU) this Thu 02:00-06:00 UTC. We'll do cohorted soft-drains + GPU node restarts to apply ASIC firmware and microcode. Expect ~15-25% GPU capacity reduction in apac-west1 and eu-west3 per cohort (45-90m window each).

samira: Copy. Which cohorts are first? any customer-facing reserved pools impacted?

alex_m: Start with non-dedicated batch pools in apac-west1 co-located racks (cohort A). Then eu-west3 lower-traffic racks (cohort B). Dedicated pools are scheduled for last-pass with explicit customer notices — we'll avoid hard evictions.

lee_ops: Oncall will run warm re-seed of KV cache after each cohort. If teams want graceful fallback to model-quantized variants, plan that now. We'll also enable routing policy: prefer us-east for latency-tolerant jobs.

maria_pm: Customer comms: can we quantify expected error spike and cost of bursting to other regions? Sales asked for numbers.

ryan_sre: Quick estimate — if we funnel 20% of APAC traffic to us-east for 1h, network/egress + burst infra is ~$2500-3500 ballpark (credits used for Dedicated burst). Error spike: small increase in 503s during drain ramp (~0.2-0.6% relative). We'll have circuit-breaker and retry windows.

alex_m: Thanks. I'll add those to the customer note. Oncall plan: @oncall-bot will page on >5% latency regression for 5m and on any 503 rate >1% sustained.

oncall-bot: scheduled page (Thu 02:30 UTC) -> runbook: "regional-upgrade-warmseed".link

samira: Ops checklist snippet — leaving here for playbook: 
```
# soft-drain + restart sequence (per node)
kubectl drain node/<node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
sleep 45
ssh node && sudo systemctl restart nvidia-device-plugin
# verify jobs requeue + warm-kv-seed
curl -sS http://kv-seed/prime?region=apac-west1
```

lee_ops: Also remember to set routing weight for canary cohort:
- apac-west1 -> 60% local, 40% fallback us-east during cohort A
- eu-west3 -> 70% local, 30% fallback us-west during cohort B

maria_pm: Timeline clarified in comms draft. We'll send to Dedicated customers 48h prior and non-dedicated banner 12h prior.

ryan_sre: Monitoring dashboards: enable per-route token latency breakdown and spike thresholds. I'll attach a short dashboard link in the runbook.

alex_m: Post-maintenance actions: run perf evals on 3 prompt sets (high-token, convo, embeddings) to detect quality regressions from any kernel changes. If regressions >2% for generation quality, rollback kernel.

samira: Who's owner for rollback?

alex_m: @lee_ops primary, @ryan_sre support. I'll be oncall for escalation.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: switch-core-upgrade v2 -> Thu 02:10 UTC (canary cohort). Check CI: all green.

lee_ops: Thanks all — I'll publish the exact cohort list (node IDs + racks) here in 30m and tag SRE for the runbook review. :thumbsup:

maria_pm: Added comm windows to the calendar invite.
